No. At that moment in Reykjavík, the Moon’s center is about **31.3° below the horizon**, so it is geometrically impossible to see directly from the ground, regardless of the clear sky, its 11% illumination, or your eyesight.

Even atmospheric refraction only helps objects very close to the horizon—roughly half a degree, not 31°. So the Moon would be **completely unobservable** then.
